subject: Registration urgency experiment + localized trigger plan for Apr webinar
messages:
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
To: alison.cho@pinebridge.com, events@pinebridge.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Registration urgency experiment + localized trigger plan for Apr webinar

Hi Alison / PineBridge events team —

Thanks again for co-promoting the April 15 webinar on scalable LLM inference. Per our sync, I sketched an annotated invite plan focused on two small experiments we think will move registration conversion without adding extra sends:

1) Urgency snippet variants in header (two-line preheader split test)
   - Variant A: "Seats filling — save your spot for Apr 15"
   - Variant B: "Limited seats for Apr 15: RSVP to reserve"

2) Localized trigger windows (timezone waves + local time CTA)
   - Wave 1 (US PT/MT): send Mon 8am local, reminder Thu 8am local
   - Wave 2 (US CT/ET): send Mon 10am local, reminder Thu 10am local

3) Snooze / RSVP reminder micro-cadence (1 leftover send per wave to non-openers)
   - Day 4: short subject + 1-line body + explicit local time string

4) Tracking link + UTM conventions (see attachment for CSV with examples)
   - utm_source=pinebridge, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=apr15_webinar, utm_content=variantA/B_wave1

Target lists: developers & platform infra leads, segmented by cloud tag (aws/gcp/azure) and company size (mid-market, enterprise). Full audience export attached for your ops team (we can restrict to PineBridge joint list).

Attachments: registration-copy-variants.xlsx (copy + subject/preheader matrix), tracking-links-utm-template.csv (sample redirects + hubspot params)

Asks / next actions:
- Alison: confirm co-send dates and whether PineBridge wants the urgency variant or the localized CTA variant prioritized.
- Marissa: prep final subject lines and shortened preheaders for mobile.
- Mateo: can you confirm tracking link TTL and click routing? We want 90-day validity and to mark HubSpot campaign correctly.

I'll schedule a 20-minute handoff if we need to walk through the CSV.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Field Marketing (West)
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415-555-0193

---
Note: we will run a quick 12-hour lift test on Variant A vs Variant B with a 10k sample prior to full send.

From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, alison.cho@pinebridge.com
Cc: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Registration urgency experiment + localized trigger plan for Apr webinar

Thanks Vanessa — this looks great and actionable. A few quick edits from Ops/Creative: 

- Subject length: aim for <= 55 chars for desktop, <= 38 for mobile. I trimmed two of the options in the attached sheet (see tab: "short_subjects").
- Preheader: Variant B's preheader reads a bit aggressive; suggest we soften to "Limited seats — RSVP to save your spot" (keeps urgency but less sales-y).
- Snooze cadence: recommend adding a midday CTA variation for exec audiences (short, calendar button) — will add a note to the copy file.

Alison — from PineBridge side, can you confirm whether you prefer the HubSpot landing or the co-branded Redwood landing? If you want your landing, please confirm the form field list (we'll need email, company, role, and cloud tag at minimum).

I'll start building the HubSpot campaign now and will drop the tracking slug in the CSV once the sample links are generated.

Marissa Cole
Campaign Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Original attachments referenced: registration-copy-variants.xlsx (updated short_subjects tab)

From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, alison.cho@pinebridge.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Registration urgency experiment + localized trigger plan for Apr webinar

Looping in tracking details and a couple of constraints from Eng: 

- Link TTL: tracking redirect service supports 365-day TTL but we default to 90 days for campaign hygiene — happy to extend if PineBridge needs longer.
- Sample redirect format: https://rwd.ai/t/abc123 -> final destination with utm params appended; sample CSV attached with per-variant tokenized slugs.
- Click dedup: we dedupe on cookie + email param to avoid double-counting on reminder sends. Be aware that calendar-button clicks sometimes double-count in HubSpot if users open in new tab; we'll mark those as "calendar_click" event.

I attached a few sample slugs in the tracking-links-utm-template.csv. I also added a short note about TTL in column G.

Two asks for schedule: 
- Vanessa: confirm whether PineBridge wants us to localize the email copy for UK/EMEA as well. That will add 1 business day to creative turnaround.
- Alison: can you share preferred speaker headshots and a short 1-line bio for the co-branded landing? We need 600x600 PNGs.

Mateo Alvarez
Growth Marketing (Tracking & Analytics)
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments: tracking-links-utm-template.csv (contains token map and sample slugs)

From: alison.cho@pinebridge.com

Hi Vanessa / team —

Thanks for the crisp plan. PineBridge is happy to run the urgency preheader (Variant A) and the localized CTA for US waves; we will keep EMEA localized copy out of scope for this send to keep timeline. Confirmed: we prefer the co-branded Redwood landing with our co-marketing fields (email, name, company, role, cloud_tag).

Attached are the speaker headshots and bios in the Drive link below — I'll share the high-res PNGs to your folder and to events@pinebridge.com by EOD.

Quick scheduling note: PineBridge requests the primary send on Apr 6 (US waves) so that our internal comms team has time to amplify on Apr 7. Does that work on your end?

Also: we prefer a slightly softer preheader as Marissa suggested — please use the softened version for Variant B. We'll run Variant A as the primary urgency test.

Best,
Alison Cho
